The decisive mistake was made by the Church_Historian_Expert at step 9. It abandoned search and wrote a scraper that used the accession number as a Met collection URL key. The Met's collection pages use object IDs, not accession numbers, so the request would likely fail, and the selectors were guessed without checking the page. The team never identified the portrait's subject, so the rest of the chain could not produce the answer.
